chapters: Jano' ba' oi'ñga' gook gu gɨ'kora' gu Dariio gu takarui' xijumai maa'n gu tanoolh gu takarui' ka't gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu ux gu novɨ jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan gu aggeo gu Sorobabeel gu mar gu Sealtiel gu gɇ'kam na ja jɨɨ'ñdha' gu Judaa gu Josuee gu mar gu Josadak jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan bham.
Jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios chugi'ñ tu ñi'ook bham; gio ba' dhi' gu ja'tkam tu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr cham gu bhóogɨt tɨbiap gu ñi'ook gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios ka't gu oi'ñga'n.
Jano' ba' ka't gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu ux gu novɨ jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan gu aggeo bham.
Jano' ba' na ba' gu ñi'ook na ba' gu ñi'ook jix koi gu vaak gu oi'ñga'n dhi' gu vaak oidha' jix gaki.
Na gu' tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios chugi'ñ; gio ba' jix duñia' xoi'kam bhaan gu bhóogɨt.

Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook jix jai' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu vaak; gio ba' kua'da' cham gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ; mi' dhɨr gu chuukug cham gu bhóogɨt; jano' ba' gu jodai' cham gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ; gio ba' gu chuukug gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ dhi'ñi gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu vaak gu jodai'.
Jano' ba' tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios chugi'ñ; gio ba' jix duñia' bhaan gu bhóogɨt.
Jano' ba' jix tɨ'ɨ gu kavɨk gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu u'u jix duñia' gu vaak; gio ba' gu bhóogɨt aagak jix duñia' nɨidhat tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios.

Jano' ba' jix duñia' jix jai' bakia' gu vaak; gio ba' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu vaak gu ñi'ook gu i'ii'ñ; mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios chugi'ñ; na gu' gu vaak oidha' jix gaki maa'n gu takarui' jix duñia' gu suudai' gu vaak.
Jano' ba' gu ux gu ñi'ook gu bhóogɨt gu tɨkɨr bhaan gu takarui' dhuuk gu oidha' gu bhóogɨt gu i'bhɨ.

Jano' ba' jup tɨɨt jix duñia' bhaan dhi' gu oidha' bhaan gu kakkavɨk bhaan tiriik bhaan suudai' u'va bhaan bɨ'ñdhatu' bhaan bɨx gu oidha' gu vaak bhaan gu chichio'ñ bhaan gu vaakax bhaan bɨx tu jiim gu noobh.

Jano' ba' jix kai gu Sorobabeel gu mar gu Sealtiel gu Josuee gu mar gu Josadak jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan bɨx gu jodai' gu ja'tkam gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu ñi'ook jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan gu aggeo na ja'p ka't gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' jix duñia' gu ja'tkam vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu aggeo gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu Jawatan Dios gu ux jix aa'ñdhix gu Jawatan Dios gu ja'tkam bham; gio ba' tu' jix duñia' bɨɨx gu ñi'ook tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios.

Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios gu Jix Chakui' I'ii'ñ gu Sorobabeel gu mar gu Sealtiel gu gɇ'kam na ja jɨɨ'ñdha' gu Judaa gu Jix Chakui' I'ii'ñ gu Josuee gu mar gu Josadak jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan gu Jix Chakui' I'ii'ñ bɨx gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ja'tkam; gio ba' tɨɨtɨs jix duu gu ñi'ook gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios chugi'ñ gu Jawatan Dios.
Na pai' dhuuk gu tanoolh gu ñi'ook maakobh gu takarui' xijumai gook oi'ñga' gu gɨ'kora' gu Dariio.
Jano' ba' gu takarui' kɨɨv gu ñi'ook maa'n gu takarui' ka't gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu ux gu novɨ jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan gu aggeo bham.
Jano' ba' tu ñi'ook jano' gu Sorobabeel gu mar gu Sealtiel gu gɇ'kam na ja jɨɨ'ñdha' gu Judaa gu Josuee gu mar gu Josadak jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ja'tkam bham.
Jano' ba' chɨkka tu' jix duñia' tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ñi'ook ka't buupui dhi' gu vaak gu ñi'ook gɇ'kamtu'nda' jano' gu kutun cham na ja'p cham tu' vupui bhaan gu vupui.

Na gu' jano' gu Sorobabeel gu takarui' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' gu takarui' gio gu Josuee gu mar gu Josadak jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan; mi' dhɨr gu bhóogɨt gu takarui' gu ja'tkam bɨx gu oidha' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios jix duñia'; na gu' tu' jix duñia' bɨɨx gu ñi'ook tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios chugi'ñ.
Jano' ba' bhaan ñi'ook na jix bhaan gu jodai' bɨɨx gu ñi'ook gu Ejipto gu Jix Chakui' I'ii'ñ gu ñi'ook tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ñi'ook; gio ba' cham gu takarui'.
Na gu' na gu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios chugi'ñ; gio ba' gu vaak gu suudai' gu bhóogɨt tu' gu chuukug gu tɨkɨr gu oidha' gu gɨ' suudai' jix gaki.
Jano' ba' gu bhóogɨt gu chuukug bɨx chɨbɨɨp ɨlhdham gu suudai' bɨx chɨbɨɨp; gio ba' gu takarui' dhi' gu vaak gɇ'kamtu'nda' tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios chugi'ñ.
Jano' ba' gu Miia jix toja jodai gu chuukug jix uam jodai tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios chugi'ñ.
Jano' ba' gɇ'kamtu'nda' gu chuukug gu vaak gu ñi'ook ka't jix gɨ' gu ñi'ook tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios chugi'ñ; gio ba' gu suudai' bhai'x i'ii'ñ dhi' pai' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios chugi'ñ.
Jano' ba' maakob jix bhai'x gu takarui' gook oi'ñga' gu Dariio ka't gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu ux gu novɨ jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan gu aggeo bham.
Jano' ba' tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios chugi'ñ; gio ba' tu ñi'ook jano' jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan gu ñi'ook ñi'ook na tu a'ga bham.

Jano' ba' tu' gu ñi'ook oi'ñdha' gu chuukug gu jodai' gu ñi'ook bɨɨx gu ñi'ook gu suudai' gu takarui' gu kutun suudai' u'va bɨ'ñdhatu' gu chuukug jugi ka't gu takarui' tu ñi'ook jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan gui'p; gio ba' cham.

Ba' jix aa' gu aggeo; gio ba' tu' ñaanbi' kuiñcha gu chuukug jix koi gu suudai' gu ñi'ook gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu suudai' ka't gu kakai' na mɨk tu da'a tu ñi'ook jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan gui'p; mi' dhɨr gu kakai' na mɨk tu da'a ka't.
Ba' jix aa' gu aggeo; gio ba' dhi' gu ja'tkam dhi' gu ja'tkam vupui bhaan tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios; mi' dhɨr gu suudai' bɨx gu ñi'ook gu noobh; jano' ba' bɨx gu jodai' ñaanbi'.
Jano' ba' jano' gu suudai' gu i'ii'ñ dɨr dhi' gu tanoolh jix duñia' va'k jaisaidhat gu jodai bhaan gu jodai vaak na jix bhaan Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' va'k bhaai'n dhi' tu'x aajidha' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ñi'ook gu suudai' ka't mambhɨɨx; gio ba' aajidha' gu bhóogɨt na ba' gu bhóogɨt mambhɨɨx gu chuukug gu bhóogɨt ka't gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu bhóogɨt bɨɨx gu jɨvɨl gu chuukug bɨɨx gu chuukug bɨɨx gu ñi'ook bɨx gu ñi'ook gu noobh; gu' cham jix duñia' tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios.

Na gu' gu suudai' jano' gu i'ii'ñ dɨr dhi' gu tanoolh jix duñia' dɨr gu tanoolh maakob jix bhai'x gu takarui' dɨr gu tanoolh mi'x juu'ñ gu suudai' vaak na jix bhaan Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' gu suudai' gu i'ii'ñ.
Jano' ba' gu suudai' cham gu kai' gu suudai' tu' gu tasi' tu' iigɨx tu' gu chuukug tu' gu u'u gu suudai' tu' gu bhóogɨt; gu' dɨr gu ñi'ook gu tanoolh gu suudai' jix bhai' aa'.
Jano' ba' ka't gookim jix duñia' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu aggeo maakob gu takarui' bham.
Jano' ba' tu ñi'ook gu Sorobabeel gu gɇ'kam na ja jɨɨ'ñdha' gu Judaa bham; gio ba' tu' gu bhóogɨt gu chuukug gu tɨkɨr gu oidha'.
Jano' ba' bhaan atooxkor oi'dha' na gɨ'kora' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu kavɨk oi'dha' na gɨ'kora' chɨbɨɨp; gio ba' bhaan gu bhóogɨt jix tɨ'ɨ; mi' dhɨr aajim gu i'ii'ñ jix duñia' gɨ' kavɨk gu ux gu kuchii xibhɨk.

Jano' ba' mii' dhɨr gu tanoolh tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios chugi'ñ tu' jix bhɨɨ gu ñi'ook gu Sorobabeel gu mar gu Sealtiel tu duukam gu chuukug gu Jawatan Dios tu' gu bhóogɨt na ja'p gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ; na gu' tu' gu oi'ñga'n tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios chugi'ñ.
